messages.subject: storing info
parts:
Hello.

I'm building an application for tracking my calorie intake, so that experiment with visualizing that information over time, and using it to aid future decisions.

https://nutwition.shinyapps.io/App2/

in global.r I define:

gValues <- reactiveValues()
gValues[["data"]] <- data.frame(some = character(0), data = numeric(0))

... in server.r I update gValues[["data"]]:

input$save_button  # from actionButton()
isolate({
  new_data <- data.frame(some = input$text, data = input$value)  # from textInput() and numericInput()
  gValues[["data"]] <- rbind(new_data, gValues[["data"]])
})

I mean to store data over time, using a browser, then providing analytics on that stored data. I can imagine why this may not be allowed (?yet?), but are there any workarounds like... say... write to and load from google docs or something weird like that.

I have a MySQL instance out on Amazon EC2 - is that something I could access from within a shinyapp? ... I haven't yet looked into how this might be possible.

Thanks,

Dan
